title: Chapter 148 Unrivaled Power
content:
Chapter 148 Unrivaled Power

Outside the city, the newly hatched Zerg in the Zerg territory began to arrive, and the first to arrive were more than 10,000 Zerg puppies.

They gathered under the city and did not participate in the battle in the city. Now the troops in the city are sufficient, and the effect of increasing the troops is not great.

Every few minutes, thousands of Zerg puppies or Hydralisks arrived and gathered under the city.

After Wu Qing discovered the evil god sacrifice ceremony in the city, he consumed all the existing gas resources in the system and hatched Zerg Hydralisks with all his strength.

At the current Zerg's rapid growth rate, the system's gas resources were consumed in a few minutes.

A total of more than 7,000 Zerg Hydralisks were hatched, increasing the total number of Zerg Hydralisks to more than 25,000.

Zerg puppies came in a steady stream. In addition to the energy resources harvested on the battlefield, the worker bees in the Zerg's underground territory were also desperately digging. Seven or eight thousand worker bees were digging frantically underground to ensure that the system's energy resources were sufficient to support the Zerg's continuous growth of puppies.

…

With the fierce attack of the Zerg, the front line continued to advance into the city, and the range of the Zerg Hydralisk on the city wall was no longer enough to support the front-line operations.

The Hydralisk began to split into small teams, led by a one-star Hydralisk, rushing down the city wall, rushing to a closer distance from the battlefield, looking for commanding heights, and continuing to support the front-line operations.

As long as the enemy's splashing and scattered attacks are kept, it will be difficult for the enemy in this state to organize an effective defense, and they can only passively be beaten and slaughtered.

On the battlefield, the Zerg host is responsible for detection, and the Zerg puppy is responsible for cleaning. The environment of the city is complex, and people can hide in many places. With the cooperation of the host, no living creature can escape from the claws of the Zerg puppy.

The evil god army also constantly dispatched troops from other parts of the city to support. Without the blessing of the faith of the sacrifice, the combat power of the evil god army cannot be compared with the current combination of the Zerg army and the elite of the alliance.

In particular, the Zerg Hydralisk has a terrible area killing attack mode, and the racial arms of the weak Lizardmen are useless no matter how many they are.

Under the Zerg biological decomposition liquid, the soldiers with insufficient protection were either dead or disabled. No matter how firm their faith was, they could not fight to the death and could only wait for death!

Some people whose brains were not completely burned by fanatical faith retreated into the building to avoid the terrifying liquid falling from the sky.

But they were no match for the Zerg puppies in the indoor environment and were slaughtered.

The black Zerg puppies quickly spread throughout the city, driving the surviving evil god camp defense army to the center of the city.

In the central square of the city, the evil god sacrifice ceremony reached the most critical moment. A milky white energy enveloped the sacrifices covered with black cloth. Those sacrifices of unknown race were gradually fading and eventually disappeared.

It looked similar to the system's matter-energy conversion, but the system's matter-energy conversion was completed instantly, without so many tricks.

As the sacrifice was successfully sacrificed, the sky and the earth changed color!

A terrible breath suddenly descended on this space!

"Welcome the spirit god to come!"

The white-robed high priest shouted loudly and knelt devoutly!

"Welcome the spirit god to come!"

All the priests and the evil god army on the square shouted loudly and knelt devoutly!

The vision here was not noticeable outside the square shrouded by mysterious energy, and even the evil god army organizing defense on the edge of the square was unaware of it!

At this moment, everything in the square seemed to be isolated from the outside world!

When the square suddenly changed, the one-star host controlled by the Queen of Insects could not perceive the situation in the square. The power of the gods came, and it seemed to strip the space where the square was located from this world!

"This kind of power is really unmatched!"

"It seems that this world does not allow such power to come directly!"

"But such power can bring changes to things in this world!"

After watching a complete evil god sacrifice ceremony, Wu Qing had an intuitive understanding of this way of sacrifice.

It is really hard to judge what kind of changes such a power that is enough to strip space will bring.

Wu Qing decisively ordered Wu Cong and Meng to retreat with their troops, and the situation on the battlefield may change soon.

Wu Cong, who received the order, summoned the scattered human army of Daxia without any hesitation, began to withdraw from the battle, and quickly evacuated outside the city.

When Meng received the order to retreat, he was personally leading the tiger cavalry to kill all around, and the cooperation with the Zerg became more and more tacit, and the evil god army was defeated step by step, without any resistance.

When the Zerg host beside him notified him to lead all the elite troops of the alliance to evacuate immediately, he was stunned for a moment.

Now the battlefield situation is very good. As long as they work harder, the big city occupied by the evil god camp will be captured soon.

But he knew Wu Qing's character very well. Without hesitation or asking the reason, he directly notified all the lords who led the army to participate in the war to leave the battlefield through the Zerg host and assemble in the rear to wait!

Because the order received was to leave the battlefield and regroup, not to evacuate, many lords thought that they were going to fight a big battle. Everyone acted according to the order, quickly left the battlefield, and assembled in the safe area behind the battlefield according to the instructions.

Meng and Hu Wei had been counting until all the elite alliance troops that had been dispersed arrived. Meng said seriously to the alliance lords who were gathered around him waiting for orders: "Order received! We need to evacuate the battlefield immediately!"

"We have to evacuate outside the city as quickly as possible!"

The alliance lords who received the evacuation order were a little puzzled. Now is a good time for them to make achievements and earn battlefield benefits. They don't want to evacuate at this time.

This is human nature, and there is nothing wrong with it!

But thinking of Wu Qing and Meng's warnings before the war, no one said anything.

Since the order has been issued, they must evacuate, but their little emotions can't be hidden.

"This attack is too smooth! The army of the evil god camp is not so weak!"

"The Zerg must have discovered the problem!"

"Everyone execute the order immediately! Don't think about it!"

Meng looks careless, but he is actually very careful. He explained to everyone so that everyone would not have any knots in their hearts.

"Yes!"

Meng's explanation made everyone feel relieved, and the little emotions in their hearts disappeared immediately.

The elite troops of the alliance quickly evacuated the city after following the Daxia army, retreated to the outside of the city and reorganized the formation.

At this time, hundreds of thousands of Zerg Zerglings and more than 7,000 Zerg Hydralisks gathered outside the city again.

Everyone was relieved to see that the Zerg had sent so many reinforcements in such a short time, and that the subsequent reinforcements continued to arrive.
